text: An agent can delete data, leak credentials, or hit production with one bad command. A prompt telling it not to is just a suggestion. Until now.
Custodian Codex Guard is a safety kernel for AI agents. It sits between any agent and the tools it calls, and decides what's actually allowed before anything happens.

The agent proposes an action. Codex Guard classifies it by what it actually does, not what it's labeled. Paladin recognizes credential references without ever exposing a secret. Every decision lands in a hash chained receipt ledger, outside the agent, outside the prompt, outside the model's reach.
This is the real output of that verification command. Escalations, denials, autonomous decisions, every one of them value free, and provably untampered.

This is real output from that exact script, captured once and replayed here so you can read it clearly. A safe read is allowed autonomously. A workspace edit is allowed. A secrets file read is denied outright. And a delete disguised as a read gets caught and escalated for a human to approve.

Codex, running GPT five point six, attacked its own classifier with commands mislabeled as safe, reading a secrets file, deploying straight to production. Both got reclassified by what they actually do, and caught. That decision is deterministic, not a model call. Nothing here can be talked out of it.

Every receipt signs the one before it. Tamper with history and the chain breaks at that exact point. An approval binds to one exact action, replay it, and it fails. If the classifier is ever uncertain, it denies. The kernel itself runs somewhere the agent can't reach.
AI agents are already moving money, deploying infrastructure, and reading credentials. The prompt is soft, a smart enough model routes around it. Custodian moves the boundary out of the model.

The code is open source at github dot com, slash Key Argo, slash custodian dash codex dash guard. One pip install, and Codex Guard runs right there in your own workspace — nothing hosted, nothing external. Get it for yourself at get custodian dot X Y Z. You stay in full control of the agent, always.
